methodology: Systematic audit of all Technical Information (TI) and documentary references historically cited in repository seed scripts and commit artifacts for serial number breakpoints.

references.claimed_semantic: Introduction of Series 1141 with M-Tronic 2.1 electronic engine management and angled cylinder shroud.
references.official_stihl_verification: NO. Public and dealer archive search reveals STIHL uses format TI [Number].[Year] (e.g. TI 51.2010), not TI-YYYY-NNN. Document was entered as a placeholder code string in early seed script without archival retrieval.
references.notes: Treated strictly as historical internal project nomenclature; cannot be used to substantiate PRIMARY_DOCUMENTED or HIGH confidence.
